# jenkins_folders (Data Source)

Lists the names of the folders directly within a Jenkins folder (or the root).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jenkins_folders" "root" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folder` (String) The parent folder to list subfolders from. If not set, the Jenkins root is listed.

### Read-Only

- `folders` (Set of String) The names of the folders directly within the parent folder.
- `id` (String) The parent folder whose subfolders are listed, or `/` for the root.
